name: @sos-2/observation
description: SOS 2.0 Observation Plane core (Work Order P7): the no-body observation loop. Folds replay-protected observation events into deterministic LIVE PROJECTIONS (repository branch heads + open PRs, latest CI runs, deployed revisions, provider health), reconciles observed revisions against System State claims with typed findings (ALIGNED / DIVERGED / UNVERIFIED / STALE — stale and unavailable are distinguishable from success, never folded), and detects shortfalls/opportunities as non-authoritative typed records for the orchestrator to consume. Observation NEVER mutates semantic truth: the loop reads the observation-event store and writes only its own projections/findings; the System State is consumed through a read-only claims port. Projections are derived views rebuilt deterministically from events — canonical semantics remain in the authoritative domain stores (§5). No body, no harness, no network: everything (clock, repositories, claims) is injected.
